prompt: Edit a service page promising guaranteed growth into an evidence-supported statement for owner review; keep all approved contractual terms intact. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Perform focused passes: meaning and factual accuracy, structure and hierarchy, sentence clarity, specificity and proof, consistency, then grammar. Preserve legal qualifiers and product semantics. Remove unsupported superlatives and formulaic filler. Show meaningful edits and flag factual questions instead of silently inventing supporting evidence.

Read the revised piece as a whole, check links/claims/CTA and compare against the original for lost meaning. Explain substantive changes; do not present an unapproved draft as published.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
